_doc: Layered semantic evaluation. Each case carries its own input and exact
expectation. require: effects that must be present. forbid: effects that
must be absent (false-positive guard). require_boundary: boundary reasons
that must be present. known_gap: an expectation the engine does not yet
meet, tracked rather than dropped. resource matchers: eq/prefix/contains/any.
